headline: Siemens reports Microchip AMS coverage and checkpoint-debug case studies
fact: A Siemens forum recap reports two Microchip posters: mixed-signal code-coverage analysis of a temperature/voltage sensor exposed RTL bugs missed by standalone digital verification; a battery-backed SRAM case used Symphony Get Analog Value and checkpoint save/restore for analog visibility and debug. The date records publication of the vendor recap.

sources.title: Siemens recap of mixed-signal customer presentations
sources.summary: November 7 vendor report distinguishes Microchip's sensor coverage study from its separate SRAM visibility and checkpoint study.
